definitions.text: kunnskap som en borger i middelalderen burde ha (grammatikk, dialektikk, logikk, retorikk, aritmetikk, astronomi og musikk)
definitions.translation: knowledge that a citizen in the Middle Ages ought to have (grammar, dialectic, logic, rhetoric, arithmetic, astronomy, and music)
broad knowledge in subjects such as language, culture, history, and natural science
